proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ E _ _ M x hM hx
  have hq : ‖(Submodule.Quotient.mk x : E ⧸ M)‖ = Metric.infDist x (M : Set E) := QuotientAddGroup.norm_mk x
  have hd : 0 < Metric.infDist x (M : Set E) := by
    rw [lt_iff_le_and_ne]
    refine ⟨Metric.infDist_nonneg, fun h => hx ?_⟩
    exact (hM.mem_iff_infDist_zero ⟨0, M.zero_mem⟩).mpr h.symm
  haveI : IsClosed (M.toAddSubgroup : Set E) := hM
  have hne : ‖(Submodule.Quotient.mk x : E ⧸ M)‖ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hq]; exact hd.ne'
  obtain ⟨g, hg1, hg2⟩ := exists_dual_vector 𝕜 (Submodule.Quotient.mk x : E ⧸ M) hne
  let π : E →L[𝕜] (E ⧸ M) := M.mkQ.mkContinuous 1 (fun y => by
    simpa using Submodule.Quotient.norm_mk_le M y)
  have hπ : ∀ y, π y = Submodule.Quotient.mk y := fun y => rfl
  have hfx : (g.comp π) x = (Metric.infDist x (M : Set E) : 𝕜) := by
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hπ, hg2, hq]
  refine ⟨g.comp π, ?_, ?_, hfx⟩
  · apply le_antisymm
    · refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one fun y => ?_
      rw [one_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hπ]
      calc ‖g (Submodule.Quotient.mk y)‖ ≤ ‖g‖ * ‖(Submodule.Quotient.mk y : E ⧸ M)‖ := g.le_opNorm _
        _ = ‖(Submodule.Quotient.mk y : E ⧸ M)‖ := by rw [hg1, one_mul]
        _ ≤ ‖y‖ := Submodule.Quotient.norm_mk_le M y
    · have hF : ∀ m ∈ M, Metric.infDist x (M : Set E) ≤ ‖g.comp π‖ * ‖x - m‖ := by
        intro m hm
        have h0 : (g.comp π) m = 0 := by
          rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hπ, (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero M).mpr hm, map_zero]
        have h1 : ‖(g.comp π) (x - m)‖ = Metric.infDist x (M : Set E) := by
          rw [map_sub, h0, sub_zero, hfx]; simp [abs_of_nonneg Metric.infDist_nonneg]
        rw [← h1]; exact ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      have hpos : 0 < ‖g.comp π‖ := by
        have h2 := hF 0 M.zero_mem
        by_contra h3
        have h4 : ‖g.comp π‖ = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp h3) (norm_nonneg _)
        rw [h4, zero_mul] at h2
        linarith
      have hle : Metric.infDist x (M : Set E) / ‖g.comp π‖ ≤ Metric.infDist x (M : Set E) := by
        rw [Metric.le_infDist ⟨0, M.zero_mem⟩]
        intro y hy
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hpos, mul_comm, dist_eq_norm]
        exact hF y hy
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hpos] at hle
      have h5 := le_of_mul_le_mul_left (by simpa using hle : Metric.infDist x (M : Set E) * 1 ≤ Metric.infDist x (M : Set E) * ‖g.comp π‖) hd
      exact h5
  · intro m hm
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hπ, (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero M).mpr hm, map_zero]
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] (M : Submodule 𝕜 E) (x : E), IsClosed (M : Set E) → x ∉ M → ∃ f : StrongDual 𝕜 E, ‖f‖ = 1 ∧ (∀ m ∈ M, f m = 0) ∧ f x = (Metric.infDist x (M : Set E) : 𝕜)
